name: Hubba
title: Descendants of Benjamin
summary: Hubba is a person mentioned in the book of Nehemiah as part of the tribe of Benjamin. He was among those who returned from exile in Babylon and settled in Jerusalem. His name appears in the genealogical records documenting Israel's return.

keyEvents.title: Listed in the Genealogy
keyEvents.description: Hubba is mentioned in the list of Benjamin's descendants who lived in Jerusalem after returning from the Babylonian exile.

keyEvents.title: The Return from Babylon
keyEvents.description: As part of the tribe of Benjamin, Hubba was among those who returned and helped rebuild the community in Jerusalem after the exile.

keyEvents.title: Settlement in Jerusalem
keyEvents.description: Hubba was among those who settled in the holy city of Jerusalem as part of the rebuilding of the Jewish community.

keyEvents.title: Genealogies in Chronicles
keyEvents.description: The genealogical line of the tribe of Benjamin, to which Hubba belonged, is also recorded in 1 Chronicles.
